title: guest_invite
description: A new guest invitation of this device. pin and deep_link are secret for 5 minutes: show them only on the inviting screen (large QR code of deep_link, the PIN to type). deep_link is the canonical pairing link (deep-link/pairing-link.json, with tls_port/fp when the hub has a certificate); a guest scans it with the camera or types the PIN in the app. grant = what the guest gets (admin defaults, display only).

deep_link.description: Canonical pairing deep link with the PIN (deep-link/pairing-link.json uri).

url.description: Base URL of the hub encoded in deep_link (for manual entry).
